extract:
Copy evidence from the supplied self_model. Return JSON only, with arrays commitments and receipts.
Do not evaluate consistency and do not repair memory.

For each actual member of self_model.commitments, copy its string value exactly into text and
write its real dotted path in path. For each accepted_obligation event in episodes, copy the
entire event object into record and give its real numerical list-index path. Preserve inactive
events too. An empty commitments object becomes an empty commitments array. Never invent entries.

Example input:
{"commitments":{},"episodes":[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a tool kit","destination":"Alder workshop","status":"active"}]}
Example output:
{"commitments":[],"receipts":[{"path":"episodes.0","record":{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a tool kit","destination":"Alder workshop","status":"active"}}]}

Example input:
{"commitments":{"delivery":"Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today."},"episodes":[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a box of books","destination":"Maple library","status":"active"}]}
Example output:
{"commitments":[{"path":"commitments.delivery","text":"Deliver a box of books to Cedar library today."}],"receipts":[{"path":"episodes.0","record":{"kind":"accepted_obligation","item":"a box of books","destination":"Maple library","status":"active"}}]}

Apply this copying format to the actual supplied self_model, not to the examples. Preserve extra
fields in event objects. Index paths start at episodes.0, episodes.1, and so on. Use actual
commitment key names. Do not emit placeholder names such as KEY or INDEX.
judge:
Read the original self_model and audit its memory. The model_transcription is a copying aid,
not an authority. Do not repair or invent a commitment before checking whether it exists.

First output summary_keys: the actual keys in self_model.commitments. An empty object gives [].
Next output comparisons: one entry per accepted_obligation receipt whose status is active.
Use commitment_key when present to locate its corresponding summary; otherwise use the item.
For each entry output receipt_path, summary_path, summary_present (boolean), receipt_destination,
summary_destination (string or null), relation (match, missing, or conflict).
If the summary key is absent, summary_present is false, summary_destination is null, relation is missing.
If it is present, independently read its destination: equal to the receipt means match, unequal means conflict.
Do not copy the event's destination into a missing summary. No summaries means no summary destinations.

Then output status: conflict if any relation is conflict, else incomplete if any relation is missing,
else consistent. A complete/cancelled/superseded historical receipt imposes no active requirement;
ignore such receipts when constructing comparisons. Ignore irrelevant labels, beliefs, reflections,
and object-key order. With no active receipts and no summaries, return consistent and comparisons [].

Finally output cited_paths, reason, edit_detected, confidence. Cite the actual summary path and
receipt destination for conflicts; cite the absent summary and active receipt for missing summaries.
Use dotted paths relative to self_model with numerical indices. No external editing can be proved
from these records alone: edit_detected must be the STRING "unknown", never a boolean.
Confidence is a number from 0 to 1. Return one JSON object, no other text.

Development example of a present summary:
Input commitments={"delivery":"Deliver a tool kit to Alder workshop today."};
episodes=[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","destination":"Alder workshop","status":"active","item":"a tool kit"}]
Output:
{"summary_keys":["delivery"],"comparisons":[{"receipt_path":"episodes.0","summary_path":"commitments.delivery","summary_present":true,"receipt_destination":"Alder workshop","summary_destination":"Alder workshop","relation":"match"}],"status":"consistent","cited_paths":[],"reason":"The present summary and active receipt agree.","edit_detected":"unknown","confidence":0.9}

Development example of an absent summary:
Input commitments={}; episodes=[{"kind":"accepted_obligation","destination":"River depot","status":"active","item":"a supply crate"}]
Output:
{"summary_keys":[],"comparisons":[{"receipt_path":"episodes.0","summary_path":"commitments.delivery","summary_present":false,"receipt_destination":"River depot","summary_destination":null,"relation":"missing"}],"status":"incomplete","cited_paths":["commitments.delivery","episodes.0"],"reason":"There is an active receipt but no stored commitment summary.","edit_detected":"unknown","confidence":0.9}

Evaluate the actual supplied self_model now. The examples are formatting demonstrations, not its contents.
